## Current roles

- CryptoRails (Feb 2026 - Present): Product Manager: coordinates an engineering team, maintains the product backlog, and runs delivery for multi-chain crypto payment and wallet infrastructure.
- Independent Consulting (Apr 2026 - Present): Independent Consultant & Product Manager: business transformation, Web3 product management, proprietary AI research, and data/ML training
- Quandatics (Apr 2026 - Present): Contractor: Business Transformation Consultant
- Quandatics Academy (Jun 2026 - Present): Contractor: Data Science & Machine Learning Trainer
- Monash University Malaysia (Dec 2025 - Present): Research Assistant: develops wastewater treatment plant prediction models using RNNs, Transformers, and Markov chain methods on time-series sensor data. Works on the [Monash Water Platform](https://monash-water-platform.vercel.app/), including the CitizenFlood Android app and operator dashboard.
- ACTBuilder (Jul 2025 - Present): Technical Consultant: supports technical documentation, builds a knowledge wiki, maintains the website, and helps set up Python environments.

## Education

- UTAR (Oct 2022 - Oct 2025): BSc (Hons), First Class Honours · Applied Mathematics with Computing
- UTAR (Oct 2021 - Oct 2022): Foundation · Science

## Public projects

- [Work index](https://jienweng.github.io/projects/)
- [VideoFlow](https://jienweng.github.io/projects/videoflow/): A video orchestration studio built with Go and SvelteKit. The Electron desktop application bundles the studio, local storage, and FFmpeg into one workspace.
- [Monash Water Platform](https://jienweng.github.io/projects/monash-water/): Part of my research assistant work at Monash University Malaysia. CitizenFlood brings water observations to an Android app; the operator dashboard supports wastewater monitoring and illustrative scenario exploration.
- [Internal CRM](https://jienweng.github.io/blog/quandatics-crm-business-transformation/): An internal CRM for Quandatics, designed around the handoffs between sales, delivery, and finance.
- [ZakatDAO](https://github.com/JienWeng/ZakatDAO): Uses smart contracts to record and distribute zakat payments.
- [FacePay](https://github.com/JienWeng/FacePay): Tests face recognition as an identity check during payment.
- [Yappy](https://github.com/JienWeng/Yappy): A chat app prototype for testing conversational flows.
- [DecimalSat](https://github.com/JienWeng/DecimalSat): Assembling a small satellite and ground station, and testing their radio link.
- [Geospatial Analysis forked from Kepler.gl](https://github.com/JienWeng/kepler.gl): A kepler.gl fork for Monash geospatial analysis and open-data sharing around the Klang Valley. In progress.
